major: Phase 0 implements the premium shell and Asset Rankings only. Deep Asset Intelligence, derivatives core, advanced derivatives, discovery expansion, public storytelling, portfolio, providers, and production readiness remain separate approval-gated phases.
The connected environment can provide an executable Figma generator and specification but cannot publish a hosted Figma file or prototype link into the user's account.
minor: The application uses a legal repository/system typography stack rather than guessing proprietary reference fonts.
Official reference screenshots may be blocked by bot protection, consent, geography, or network access; the artifact records failures instead of fabricating images.
The static review universe uses deterministic Qelly observations and does not reproduce proprietary market datasets.
Table virtualization architecture is preserved for later large-universe integration; the static review renders a bounded deterministic universe.
The light appearance is an analytical accessibility variant and not a full public-editorial redesign.
deliberate: Burgundy is limited to identity and selected emphasis while neutral surfaces dominate.
The ranking table precedes the chart and is the primary product surface.
Mobile uses prioritized expandable rows instead of a squeezed desktop table.
The chart uses realistic deterministic OHLC, volume, OI and funding rather than copied data or a synthetic sine wave.
One compact status center replaces repeated demo badges.
Source, freshness, confidence, provider disagreement, Explain This Move and Decision Provenance remain Qelly-specific differentiators.
The previous HTML is retained only as a structural prototype and is excluded from the compiled preview.
approvalGate: DO NOT MERGE — USER VISUAL APPROVAL REQUIRED
